basic_details.job_title: OAV Khunta Assistant Cook Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Khunta (OAV Khunta) has announced 2 vacancies for the Assistant Cook post on a contract basis, with applications to be sent by Speed or Registered post to Principal Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya on or before the last date of receiving application on 27 October 2026. The engagement is for a period of one year, offering a pay of Rs. 6,750 per month. Eligible male candidates applying for the boys' hostel must be able to stay 24x7, be well conversant to use LPG, maintain hygiene habits, and have preference if trained in cookery.

qualification.details: Other Requirements: | Must be a male candidate for Boys’ hostel. Must be in position to stay in the hostel 24×7. Must be well conversant to use LPG. Must maintain perfect hygiene in dresses while cooking and have good cooking habits. Preference and due weightage will be given to individuals trained in cookery. Ability to cook any dishes on time with due care towards hygiene and deliciousness.

selection_process: Preference shall be given to local candidates. If candidates are not available in that locality
then the block will be taken as a unit. If still candidates are not available
candidates from nearby blocks may be selected. No candidates outside of the district should be recruited.

Rs. 6,750/- per month (including EPF share of Employee & Employer)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Filled in application with all documents must be sent in an application envelope super scribed with “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASSISTANT COOK FOR BOYS HOSTEL” through Speed/Registered post only to the following address: PRINCIPAL ODISHA ADARSHA VIDYALAYA,AT- LAKHMANSAHI, PO- LAKHMANSAHI,BLOCK- KHUNTA, DIST- MAYURBHANJ,PIN – 757075, ODISHA

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Other Requirements: Must be a male candidate for Boys’ hostel. Must be in position to stay in the hostel 24×7. Must be well conversant to use LPG. Must maintain perfect hygiene in dresses while cooking and have good cooking habits. Preference and due weightage will be given to individuals trained in cookery. Ability to cook any dishes on time with due care towards hygiene and deliciousness.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: HSC Certificate & Mark Sheet +2 Certificate & Mark Sheet B.A. / B.Sc. Certificate & Mark Sheet (if applicable) Caste Certificate Aadhar Card Residential Certificate Experience Certificate in Hostel Management Passport size photograph (2 Nos) Other supporting documents mentioned in the application

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Preference shall be given to local candidates. If candidates are not available in that locality, then the block will be taken as a unit. If still candidates are not available, candidates from nearby blocks may be selected. No candidates outside of the district should be recruited.

rows.details: Download prescribed proforma from official website

faq.question: Q1. Is this job permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The engagement is on a contract basis for a period of one year. On expiry, fresh engagement shall be made with a gap of at least one working day based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for the Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: Male candidates aged between 21 and 32 years as on the date of advertisement who can stay 24x7 in the boys' hostel, use LPG, and maintain hygiene are eligible.

faq.question: Q3. Are candidates from outside the district allowed to apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates from outside Mayurbhanj district are not eligible to be recruited against the stated post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications through Speed or Registered post is 27 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.
